SimPO cites Arena-Hard as **reference [54]**:

> Tianle Li, Wei-Lin Chiang, Evan Frick, Lisa Dunlap, Banghua Zhu, Joseph E. Gonzalez, and Ion Stoica. *From live data to high-quality benchmarks: The Arena-Hard pipeline*, April 2024.

This entry is in the References section, which starts on p. 11. The document doesn't give the exact page of entry [54].

The paper uses this citation in several places:
- **p. 1**: The introduction calls it "the challenging Arena-Hard [54] benchmark."
- **p. 5**: The evaluation section names "Arena-Hard v0.1 [54]" as one of three main benchmarks. Table 2 cites [54] and describes the benchmark as 500 examples, with GPT-4-0314 as the baseline model and GPT-4 Turbo as the judge.
- **p. 6**: The Table 4 caption cites "Arena-Hard [54]."
- **p. 7**: The paper says its finding that MT-Bench separates methods poorly "aligns with observations reported in [54]."
